description: List AI models tracked by Modelglass across image, LLM, video, and audio modalities, with current pricing and technical profile. By default returns only current-generation models. Pass generation='all' to include previous generations, or generation='previous' to see superseded models only.

arch.description: Filter to an architecture vocabulary id.

generation.description: Filter by model generation. 'current' (default) returns only active-generation models; 'previous' returns superseded generations; 'all' returns every generation.

modality.description: Filter to a modality group: image, llm, video, or audio.

provider.description: Filter to a provider slug, e.g. 'replicate'. A canonical company id (e.g. 'google', 'openai', 'together') expands to that company's offerings across every vertical it spans (image/llm/video/audio) instead of just one raw slug.

name: modelglass_list_models

items.description: A model grouped across providers: the join of its pricing offerings and ontology knowledge (capability profile, benchmarks, architecture).

knowledge.description: Null for pricing-only models with no ontology entry yet.

credit_pricing.description: Prices in the provider's own credits (e.g. Luma API credits), gated by plan like `pricing`.

items.description: A price in the provider's own credits (e.g. Luma API credits); never converted to USD.

effective_to.description: Inclusive last day. Absent while current.

corrected.description: Present when this row replaces one Modelglass recorded wrongly: a wrong price, or the right price with the wrong dates. The wrong row itself is never served.

at.description: When the wrong row was corrected.

note.description: A fixed public sentence saying what was recorded wrongly: the price, or only the dates (the amount was correct).

recorded_at.description: Date Modelglass first recorded this row (set on correction replacement rows).
